title: Refactor Error Handling
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 error handling using 'On Error Resume Next' is non-transparent and risky.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of non-transparent error handling may lead to undetected errors.
suggested_approach: Refactor to use C# try-catch blocks for error handling.
success_criteria: All error handling uses try-catch blocks in C#.
